name: E&O
recent: E&O 近期主要出现董事与大股东在公开市场持续增持股份的申报，以及 ICULS 转换为普通股的新股上市。新闻方面，公司提出以 Penang 增长为基础，目标 FY2027 达到 RM1b 产业销售，并公布 1Q 净利按年增长 28%。
notable: 执行主席 Dato' Seri Tee Eng Ho 与执行董事 Dato' Tee Eng Seng 通过 Amazing Parade Sdn Bhd 在公开市场多次增持公司股份。
公司因 ICULS 转换为普通股，发行 20,000 股新股，并于 2026 年 11 月 19 日上市。
新闻报导 E&O 以 Penang 增长为基础，目标 FY2027 达到 RM1b 产业销售。
risks: 董事与大股东在公开市场及闭门期内的交易申报频繁，需留意后续股权变动。
ICULS 持续转换为普通股，可能逐步增加流通股数量。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 281.471 million，按年增长 53.4%，按季增长 19.3%；净利为 MYR 58.111 million，按年增长 27.9%，按季下降 6.3%；净利率为 20.6%，低于上一季度的 26.3%。

recent_en: E&O recently saw a series of filings on directors and a major shareholder acquiring shares in the open market, along with the listing of new shares from ICULS conversion. In the news, the company targets RM1b property sales for FY2027 on Penang growth and reported a 28% year-on-year rise in 1Q net profit.
notable_en: Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Tee Eng Ho and Executive Director Dato' Tee Eng Seng, via Amazing Parade Sdn Bhd, acquired shares in the open market on multiple occasions.
The company issued 20,000 new shares from ICULS conversion, listed on 19 November 2026.
News reported that E&O targets RM1b property sales for FY2027, anchored on Penang growth.
risks_en: Frequent filings on open market and closed period dealings by directors and a major shareholder warrant attention to subsequent shareholding changes.
Ongoing ICULS conversion into ordinary shares may gradually increase the number of shares in circulation.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 281.471 million, up 53.4% year-on-year and 19.3% quarter-on-quarter; net income was MYR 58.111 million, up 27.9% year-on-year but down 6.3% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 20.6%, lower than 26.3% in the previous quarter.
